deviations.reason: [screen] sealed state lists only the total, not the brought-forward lines, and names no certifier or date; 'Open FY 2027–28' door absent. The ✓ is [shared] glyph coverage: none of the bundled faces (Mukta, Mukta Mahee, Noto Sans — checked with fontTools) maps U+2713, so a phone draws it in its platform fallback face (design_capture.dart:76-78 — only the harness draws a box); close.year.sealed.badge. The FY switcher pill is required here (ADR 2026-09-09 §4 🔒) — the frame's note card describes it instead of drawing it
deviations.authority: 07 §13 🔒 (closed years show *Certified ✓ FY 2026-27*); ADR 2026-09-09 §4 🔒 (FY switcher on S4 · S8.2 · S10.4); 11 §4.4
